rows.note: Use this as the usual everyday expression when someone sings songs or performs vocally.

example.english: My mum often asks me to sing songs to amuse my little brother.
example.traditional: 我阿媽成日叫我唱歌氹細佬。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 giu3 ngo5 coeng3 go1 tam2 sai3 lou2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb, especially when the musical context is already clear.

example.english: It's your turn to sing, don't look at me.
example.traditional: 輪到你唱喇，唔好望住我。
example.jyutping: leon4 dou3 nei5 coeng3 laa3 m4 hou2 mong6 zyu6 ngo5
